tests: task-family acquisition through ordinary writeback and transfer
multi-episode progression chronology is independent of request order
same model/generation profile permits descriptive comparability
changed effective generation ceiling prevents comparability
restarted owner reconstructs identical report without additional invocation

implementation.chronology: Digest-verified completed_ticks order; never caller order or recovery wall time.
implementation.claim_boundary: Score progression remains descriptive task correctness. Fixture inference is marked non-synthetic-inference-verified=false; performance improvement and learning are always false.
implementation.controls: Per-condition model ID, artifact digest, active serving identity, generation-configuration digest, and aggregate profile digest are bound into each bounded episode.
implementation.metric: Correct probe counts with exact denominator per history-present, withheld, and restored condition; task instance and probe-set identities must be distinct for comparability.
implementation.recovery: Read-only reconstruction from completed request custody; reports no inference replay. Incomplete referenced episodes return explicit incomplete status.
implementation.verification: Reconstructs exact requests, completed cognition checkpoints, experiment runs, objective scores, and each governed invocation receipt using existing owner verifiers.

objective: Report a bounded chronology of verified family-task episodes with exact model/generation controls and explicit non-learning semantics.
